jobs.title: Associate Manager, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Integrated Supply Chain Manager owns the end-to-end demand-to-delivery cycle for the market, bringing together demand planning/S&OP and logistics/order management into a single point of accountability.

The role supports overall business revenue and profit delivery through rigorous management of demand signals across product and customer channels, and through efficient logistics, fulfilment and order management execution.

The role partners Commercial leadership and works across multi-functional teams — Sales, Marketing, Finance, Logistics and Supply Planning — to assure alignment and sufficiency in the business plans to deliver anticipated demand, while ensuring smooth supply chain operations and best-in-class customer service.

This requires balancing every aspect of the supply chain: managing inventory levels and cost-to-serve, minimizing shortages, and delivering a responsive supply chain through high demand forecast accuracy and OTIF delivery performance, in adherence with global process design and regional/market strategy.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Demand Planning & S&OP

▪ Deliver the Demand Management process: generate a consensus forecast of phased demand at the appropriate planning level on a 12 to 18months horizon, owning enrichment of the forecast to create and publish a consensus.

▪ Execute monthly demand management cycles; co-pilot the commercial leader to drive the Demand Review (DMR) with commercial teams, gain approval of the recommended forecast, and define risks, opportunities and the actions commercial teams will take to drive or influence demand.

▪ Collaborate with statistical modellers on historical data cleansing to ensure data accuracy as a foundation for reliable statistical forecasts, recording all adjustments and assumptions (channel trends, seasonality, promotions).

▪ Analyze multiple variables to shape the demand forecast — shipment/sell-in, POS/sell-out, share, promotional plans, cannibalisation — and collaborate with Sales and Marketing on activity plans and promotional effectiveness.

▪ Own Demand Management KPIs (Mixed Error, Forecast Bias, FVA), leading forecast accuracy improvement plans through root cause analysis and action planning with demand planners, brand and sales teams.

▪ Ensure phased consensus forecast numbers are aligned with financial numbers and proactively communicate demand changes to the regional supply/demand planning organisation, working through service and inventory impacts.

2. Logistics, Fulfilment & Order Management

▪ Formulate, execute and continuously optimise logistics strategy across warehousing, transportation and order fulfilment to ensure On-Time-In-Full (OTIF) delivery.

▪ Oversee day-to-day fulfilment and order management operations — order entry, verification and processing in SAP/ERP — to meet performance, cost-to-serve, warehouse accuracy and inventory turnover targets.

▪ Act as escalation point for customer and sales enquiries on order status, delivery schedules and product availability, partnering with the warehouse and 3PL network to ensure stock availability.

▪ Lead implementation and testing of new order management and logistics systems and process upgrades and maintain SOPs and business continuity/recovery plans.

3. Vendor, Stakeholder & Regional Alignment

▪ Build strong vendor and 3PL partnerships through performance evaluations, service-level negotiations and cost-efficiency initiatives.

▪ Partner with category planners to reconcile brand forecasts with regional plans and collaborate with the regional Demand Planning and Global Supply Chain/Logistics teams to deliver a seamless plan-to-delivery outcome.

▪ Support the market's business planning process in partnership with the local Leadership Team and contribute to product rationalisation and portfolio optimisation.

4. Process & Performance Management

▪ Drive continuous improvement of daily, weekly and monthly routines within the cross-functional operational team (Marketing, Sales, Supply/Demand Planning, Logistics) to optimise end-to-end supply chain performance, service to customer and customer experience.

▪ Drive performance improvement through KPI management — Mixed Error, Forecast Bias, Demand Plan Stability, OTIF, cost-to-serve — challenging local teams and setting targets, supported with clear action plans.

▪ Ensure compliance with the global forecasting calendar, SOX controls, ISO standards and legal/regulatory requirements across order management and logistics operations.

REQUIREMENTS

Domain Knowledge:

▪ Highly skilled in demand planning management and/or logistics/order management (5-7 years+), with strong business acumen and proven managerial skills.

▪ Highly skilled in working with Commercial and Sales teams, with strong business partnering, significant impact & influence.

▪ Experienced in international matrix environments; FMCG or similarly mature inventory-management industry preferred.

▪ Degree or equivalent in Supply Chain Management or related discipline; APICs desirable.

▪ Proficient with SAP/SAP B1 (B1/APO), SCM/ERP and WMS platforms, Logility (or equivalent forecasting tool), PowerBI and advanced Excel.

▪ Familiarity with 3PL operations across Asia is an advantage.

▪ Advanced understanding of demand planning and logistics best practices, including forecast periodicity, statistical models, warehousing, transportation and order fulfillment.

Communication Skills

▪ Data Visualization: ability to present data and forecasting/logistics results clearly through visualizations using tools such as PowerBI.

▪ Reporting Skills: competence in generating insights in clear and concise reports.

▪ Collaboration: ability to work effectively in teams and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Skills:

▪ Deep expertise in running the Demand Management process through an Integrated Business Planning framework driving S&OP.

▪ Deep understanding of internal and external drivers of demand volatility, forecast errors and bias, and logistics KPIs (fulfillment rates, cycle times, shipping costs).

▪ Ability to build and maintain forecasting models, operational dashboards, and translate large datasets into demand and logistics strategies.

Abilities & Behaviours

▪ Excellent influencing, stakeholder engagement and interpersonal skills; business partnering at the core, with the ability to challenge senior stakeholders and hold tension in S&OP conversations to drive the right outcome.

▪ Sound commercial and financial acumen; can interpret and explain complex statistical information.

▪ Exceptional communication skills, verbal, written, and presentation.

▪ Good understanding of product, brand building, internal process and market/customer environment.

▪ Strong, fact-based decision-making; drives execution, initiates action and follows through to completion.

▪ Continuous improvement mindset – flexible, embraces change, uses various tools and techniques to solve problems.

▪ Thinks and operates in a global context.

▪ Team player and thinker in terms of solutions derived from sound analysis.

▪ Flexible, self-starter with a high degree of independence.

▪ Excellent ability to work and communicate in multi-functional, multi-geography teams with English as the common business language.

Purpose of Role

As Finance Director – APAC, you will serve as the senior finance leader and strategic co-pilot to Hasbro's APAC Commercial Leadership Team. This is a broad, high-impact role that combines Sales Finance (commercial business partnering, pricing, customer P&Ls, and investment strategy) with Regional Finance (A&P and overhead stewardship, planning and consolidation) across the region.

This is a key leadership role in Hasbro's International Commercial Markets. You will own the full finance agenda for APAC — from commercial deal-making and channel strategy through to regional planning, cost discipline, and consolidated reporting — giving you end-to-end visibility and influence over the region's financial performance.

This role is built for a bold, energetic leader who combines sharp financial acumen with commercial instincts, thrives in ambiguity and change, and is ready to build and lead a high-performing, multi-market team. Driving the region to sustainable profitability is the #1 challenge — and this role is central to achieving that.

What You'll Do:

Commercial Strategy & Decision Support (Sales Finance)
• Partner with the APAC Commercial Leadership Team to drive business performance across key markets, channels, and franchises.
• Lead pricing strategy, channel investment, profitability analysis, and customer P&L decisions.
• Act as a strategic architect — identify revenue growth opportunities and unlock margin through smart trade-offs.

Investment Planning & Regional Finance
• Partner with the Regional Head of Marketing and Head of Customer Marketing to align investment and promotional strategy.
• Lead line plan pricing recommendations across the region, supporting commercial market decision-making.
• Drive disciplined oversight of A&P and overheads across APAC.
• Lead the regional planning rhythm: weekly sales tracking, monthly business reviews, and financial performance reporting.
• Manage in-year performance processes, ensuring accurate, timely visibility of risks, opportunities, and sufficiency.
• Lead budgeting and forecasting processes across the region.
• Own regional consolidation, ensuring accurate roll-up of market-level results into the APAC view and clean handoff to Corporate Finance.

Leadership & Team Building
• Lead a combined Sales Finance and Regional Finance organization of 11 across Singapore, Hong Kong, China, India, and Australia, through 4 direct reports: Senior Finance Manager – Regional Finance, Senior Finance Manager – Sales Finance (Asia Markets), Finance Manager – Sales Finance (PAC & GEM), and a Finance Analyst – PAC & GEM who reports directly to the FD rather than through the PAC & GEM Finance Manager, by design.
• Build a culture of accountability, insight, and ownership — finance as co-pilot, not just scorekeeper.
• Actively coach and stretch team members; foster internal mobility and talent succession across a geographically dispersed team.

Strategic Alignment
• Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Global Franchise Teams, and Supply Chain to ensure strategic alignment.
• Bring best-practice commercial and regional finance discipline into APAC, drawing on global standards.

Reporting & Analytics
• Deliver impactful financial dashboards and management reporting to drive decision-making.
• Collaborate with BI and systems teams to modernize tools and enhance forecast accuracy.

Financial Stewardship
• Drive compliance with financial policies and controls in partnership with Controllership and Corporate Finance.
• Protect the integrity of the financials while accelerating business momentum.

What We Are Looking For:
• 10–12+ years in Finance with a strong track record spanning Commercial Finance, FP&A, and business partnering.
• Experience in CPG, retail, consumer tech, or fast-paced, brand-led industries.
• Clear success leading high-performing, multi-market finance teams.

This leader will shape how our brands show up in the world; building distinctive creative platforms and identities that connect with consumers, stand out in culture and drive commercial impact.

Leading our front-end Brand Experience organization, you will set the creative vision for the portfolio and build the teams, standards and tools needed to bring that vision to life globally. You’ll partner closely with Brand Marketing, Product Design & Development, Commercial, Licensing and our Global Creative Studio to connect brand strategy to execution across every consumer touchpoint. The mandate is simple: build brands that cut through the noise and move with culture.

A day in the life:

• Set the creative vision for our toys and board games portfolio. Translating business, brand and commercial strategies into distinctive creative platforms that can scale globally.
• Own brand creative strategy across Action, Fashion, Preschool, Nerf, Play-Doh and Board Games, ensuring each brand has a differentiated and culturally relevant expression.
• Lead the front-end of brand development, including brand creative strategy, creative direction, visual and verbal identity, brand guidelines and creative toolkits.
• Build brands, not just campaigns. Establish enduring creative systems that strengthen brand equity while creating the flexibility to stay relevant across audiences and channels.
• Champion consumer and cultural insight as a creative catalyst. Ensure our creative work starts with a deep understanding of the audiences we serve.
• Partner with cross-functional partners to ensure brand vision translates with excellence across packaging, retail, digital, social, licensing and entertainment.
• Raise the creative bar. Establish clear standards for creative excellence and continually challenge our teams and partners to push beyond category conventions and the expected.
• Lead, inspire and develop a high-performing brand creative team with a culture of ambition, curiosity, collaboration and accountability.
• Influence at the highest levels of the organization, advocating for creative vision with senior leaders and bringing stakeholders along through clear, persuasive storytelling.
• Shape the future of creative at Hasbro, embracing emerging technology, AI and new modes of storytelling to evolve how we build brands and connect with consumers.

What you'll bring:

• 15+ years of progressive creative leadership experience within world-class consumer brands, creative agencies or similarly complex brand environments.
• Experience leading multi-brand portfolios and building distinctive brands that live across both commerce and culture.
• A body of work that demonstrates strategic thinking and measurable brand impact, not just great execution.
• Deep expertise in brand building, creative strategy, creative direction, visual and verbal identity and integrated brand systems.
• Fluency across channels, with a strong understanding of how brand ideas translate across physical, digital, social, retail, experiential and emerging consumer experiences.
